chunks: Ibn Rabah in the Book of Fasting from the hadith of Hudhayfah ibn Mansur from Mu'adh ibn Kathir, who said: I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

The people say that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) fasted twenty-nine days, more than he fasted thirty. He said: 'They lie. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) did not fast less than thirty days since Allah sent him until He took his soul, and the month of Ramadan has not been less than thirty days and nights since Allah created the heavens.'
Then he mentioned this hadith from another chain, and it is
ai.seo_question: How many days did the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) fast according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) uses this narration to establish the canonical thirty-day duration of Ramadan as a fixed cosmic ordinance, refuting the notion of variable lunar months in religious practice. This hadith, recorded in Al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, underscores the consistency of the Prophet’s worship and serves as a foundational proof for the standardization of the fasting month in Shia jurisprudence.
